checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Reel starts with the café storefront, keeping striped awning and outdoor tables
must.why: Clip 1 opens on the navy-and-cream striped awning with wooden folding tables and chairs. It is recreated rather than the exact photo, but it is clearly the same café.

must.item: Attached latte and pastry counter both recognisable in later shots
must.why: The latte clip clearly matches the photo: leaf on foam, marble table and white cup. No croissant clip was supplied, so the pastry counter could not be checked.

must.item: Opening text 'Maple Street Café' and closing text 'Your morning starts here'
must.why: No on-screen text appears in any frame I saw. The user was asked about text and never gave wording, but this item expects both lines.

must.item: Gentle visible movement and framing without stretching
must.why: The storefront pushes in and the latte shot drifts and orbits slowly. The 9:16 crop looks undistorted.

must.item: Vertical, about 9 s, soft upbeat music with no speech
must.why: The video is vertical 480x858 and the reply says 9 s, in three 3 s clips. The audio could not be heard. The supplied wav is 15 s, which does not match 9 s.

faults.what: Neither required text line appears: no opening title and no closing tagline.
The scenes are AI recreations, not the original photos. The storefront has a different street and lamp, and the latte differs slightly, though it is recognisable.
The reply says the video was not watched. Only two of the three clips were available, so the pastry shot is unverified.
The soundtrack wav is 15 s against a 9 s request.

summary: The vertical storefront and latte clips look good and recognisable with gentle motion, but the required title 'Maple Street Café' and tagline 'Your morning starts here' are missing, and the pastry shot could not be verified.
